Way of the Open Hand.description: Monks of the Open Hand are the ultimate masters of martial arts combat, using subtle techniques to manipulate foes.

3.name: Open Hand Technique
3.tldr: Add tactical effects (knock prone, push away, or strip reactions) whenever you hit with Flurry of Blows.

6.name: Wholeness of Body
6.tldr: Gain a pooled well of self-healing energy to recover hit points as an action.

11.name: Tranquility
11.tldr: Cast the Sanctuary spell on yourself as if starting a long rest, protecting you from attacks.

17.name: Quivering Palm
17.tldr: Set up lethal vibrations in a target's body with an unarmed strike, unleashing instant death or massive damage.

Way of Shadow.description: Monks of the Way of Shadow follow a tradition that values stealth, espionage, and sudden ambushes.

3.name: Shadow Arts
3.tldr: Cast dark spells (Minor Illusion, Darkness, Darkvision, Pass Without Trace, Silence) and use shadows for stealth.

6.name: Shadow Step
6.tldr: Teleport from one area of dim light or darkness to another as a bonus action with advantage on your next attack.

11.name: Cloak of Shadows
11.tldr: Weave shadows around yourself to become completely invisible in dim light or darkness.

17.name: Opportunist
17.tldr: Exploit enemy openings to make a reaction attack whenever a creature near you is hit by someone else.

Way of the Four Elements.description: Monks who harness the primal elements, bending earth, fire, water, and air to their martial will.

3.name: Disciple of the Elements
3.tldr: Learn elemental disciplines that let you cast magical elemental spells by spending ki points.

6.name: Elemental Discipline
6.tldr: Learn an additional elemental discipline option.

11.name: Elemental Discipline
11.tldr: Learn another advanced elemental discipline option.

17.name: Elemental Discipline
17.tldr: Learn a final master-tier elemental discipline option.
